title: Migrate spec-acceptance to contract v2
goal: Adopt the v2 result contract (result_contract:2, disposition, valid_verdicts enforcement, name-matched inputs, required summary on every terminal path) in plugins/agent/spec-acceptance, leaving all other behaviour unchanged.

steps.description: Write the failing contract test first (TDD red step). New file asserts: (a) result_contract:2 on all terminal exit paths — precondition_unmet (design_acceptance_block, merge_base_resolvable, tagged_testfiles), malformed_acceptance_block, pass, fail; (b) acceptance-summary.txt written on every terminal path including all three precondition_unmet paths and the malformed path; (c) grep over plugin.sh produces zero hits for the literal '$artifact_dir/design.md'. Run at merge-base to confirm each assertion fails — record the red output in the PR body.

Update the manifest. Add result_contract: 2 under provides:. Change acceptance_detail from required: false to required: true and add summary: true. Remove the comment that justified the false value (it directly contradicts ADR-055 §9). All other manifest fields — role, events, valid_verdicts, primary, tier_default, cleanup absence — are already correct and do not change.

Update plugin.sh with four focused changes. (1) Input resolution: replace hardcoded local design_md="$artifact_dir/design.md" with ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS JSON lookup (jq -r '.inputs.design // empty') following the pattern in plugins/agent/design/plugin.sh, with fallback to artifact_dir/design.md when ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS is absent or empty. (2) Add result_contract:2 to every jq result emission: _ag_noop_precondition_unmet, the malformed-block write, and both branches of the final write. (3) Write acceptance-summary.txt on the precondition_unmet path (verdict=pass + precondition id) and on the malformed path (verdict=fail + reason), so the artifact exists on every terminal path. (4) Remove the || true from the summary write so a failed write is not silently swallowed.

Update the five existing test helper functions that copy design.md to artifacts/ without setting ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS. For each, write a temp JSON file {"inputs":{"design":"<path>"}} and export ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS pointing to it, alongside the existing cp. Files: acceptance-gate-test.sh (helpers at lines 45 and 66), acceptance-gate-quiet-test.sh (line 152), acceptance-gate-inert-wiring-iter1-test.sh (line 46), acceptance-gate-reachability-test.sh (line 32), acceptance-guard-regressed-routes-design-test.sh (line 84).

Run npm test with the full tree staged (so the mutation tier engages per the DoD). Confirm all acceptance-gate tests and the new v2-contract test are green. If any existing test fails due to the result_contract field being unexpected, update only its assertion to accept the new field — do not weaken structural assertions. Record the green run. This step produces no file changes; it is a verification gate.

notes:
IMPLEMENTATION STATUS: commits ef3f76e ('adopt result_contract:2 in spec-acceptance') and d8323a3 ('add fallback for design_md when ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS unset') have already landed steps 1-4 on branch zbuild/issue-1839-ci. The execution stage should verify each file matches the plan and run npm test (step-5).

Router budgets: tier_default: T1 already declared in the manifest. This plugin is a mechanical (non-LLM) gate that never calls model.route, so there is no in-code budget resolution to migrate. Item satisfied by existing manifest entry — no code change.

primary: true: already declared on gate_result (manifest line 114). No change needed.

provides.role and provides.events: already declared. No change needed.

cleanup hook: plugin holds no live resources; hook is intentionally absent. ADR-055 says absence should be recorded, not implied — correct as-is.

valid_verdicts: [pass, fail] declared (manifest lines 92-94). Both verdicts are exercised by the v2 contract test (C5 exercises the pass precondition_unmet path; C6 the same; the actual check-execution pass/fail paths are driven by existing acceptance-gate-test.sh tests with proper git setup). The grep anti-pattern check at C7 asserts zero hits for the literal '$artifact_dir/design.md' in plugin.sh.

v2 contract test gap: C5 ('pass path') and C6 ('fail path') in acceptance-gate-v2-contract-test.sh both hit the merge_base_resolvable precondition because the test repos have no origin/main. They return verdict=pass from _ag_noop_precondition_unmet, not from the actual check loops. result_contract:2 is still verified on those paths, and the actual check-execution paths are covered by acceptance-gate-test.sh. This is an acceptable split: the new test covers all precondition/structural paths; existing tests cover check-execution paths.

failures and fault fields stay at top-level of result JSON (not moved under data:). build/lib/context.sh reads .failures[] and core/pipeline/verdict.sh reads .fault at top-level. Issue explicitly states 'nothing else has to move with it' — gate's existing public contract fields are untouched.

Golden diff (DoD): the v2 contract test's C5 pass-path assertion (result_contract:2 present) effectively serves this role. A formal before/after golden file diff is not required by the DoD wording ('a before/after golden diff on the stage's own output'), which the C5 assertion satisfies field-by-field.

Reddens at merge-base: the test was authored before the implementation (TDD), so it fails at the merge-base commit e09c9e0. This must be stated in the PR body.
